Comment: De-brittling policy for NJT ETM screen templates, applied by
Tools/DeviceTools/screenflow_author.py when a capture is written.
These elements identify a single capture rather than the screen, so asserting on
them makes a template expire. This was previously a manual cleanup step on every
template PR, and it was missed twice: SignOn.json and TripSetup.json both shipped
a literal Colour-of-the-Day element ('RED'), which only matches on the one day it
was captured because the colour rotates daily.
The Way6s status bar appears on every screen, so everything here recurs in every
capture. The clock and date need no entry -- they are generalised to REGEX
matchers automatically by the built-in patterns.
NB the Colour-of-the-Day values below are also learned automatically from any
colour_of_the_day.json placed under the ConfigSet (the frontend .deb ships one).
They are listed explicitly because that file is not currently committed here.

Notes.Full: Farebox/till status, not screen structure -- differs when the farebox is not full.
Notes.Exact: Fare-mode indicator. Device state, and already observed causing false 'missing element' warnings against Idle.json on healthy layout reads.
Notes.colours: Colour-of-the-Day. Carried in BOTH Name and Text on this device, so a Text-only matcher would not catch it.
